Your body has an internal clock called the circadian rhythm, and it thrives on predictability. Try to go to bed and wake up at the same time every day—even on weekends. This consistency trains your brain to release melatonin at the right time, making it easier to fall asleep and wake up naturally. If you often struggle to fall asleep, a common trick is to go to bed 15–30 minutes earlier than your desired bedtime, so you can wind down without being rushed.

## 6. Move Your Body Regularly
